args.body:
Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website at www.dora-website.com and wanted to share some feedback.

What I liked:
- It's clean and easy to read — the page loads with a clear, simple introduction that immediately tells visitors who the site belongs to.
- It's nicely personal and appropriately minimal, which makes it feel authentic rather than like a template.

Suggestions for improvement:
- Add a bit more substance: a short bio, a few links to your projects or work, and maybe a photo or a section heading so visitors have something to explore.
- Include a way to get in touch (e.g., a contact form, email link, or social media links) so people know how to reach you.
- A small "About Me" or "Recent Work" section would make the site feel more complete and professional.

Overall, a nice, tidy starting point — with a few more sections it could really shine. Great luck with it!

Hi Eve! I just had a look at your blog at www.eve-blog.com and wanted to share some feedback.

What I liked:
- The blog has a warm, personal feel — I can tell it's genuinely yours.
- I love that you mention hiking as a favorite hobby; that's a great hook and gives the blog a clear personality and theme.
- The tone is friendly and approachable, which makes the blog inviting to read.

Suggestions for improvement:
- Add a few actual blog posts or entries with titles and dates, so there's more to browse and visitors can see what you write about.
- Consider organizing content into categories or tags (e.g., Hiking, Travel, Personal) to make it easier to navigate.
- A short intro paragraph about what the blog is about, plus links to your social media, would help readers connect and follow along.
- Photos from your hikes would add a lot of visual appeal and personality.

Overall, a lovely concept with a distinctive voice — adding some posts and structure would make it even better. Keep up the good work!
